description: Given a Prefect dbt integration (DbtCoreOperation, ShellOperation running dbt CLI, or DbtCloudJob), author the matching Orchestra pipeline YAML — DBT_CORE/DBT_CORE_EXECUTE for dbt Core, DBT/DBT_RUNJOB for dbt Cloud — consolidating a commands list into a semicolon-joined string and carrying project_dir/package_manager over as real task parameters.

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect dbt flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_core_operation_poetry.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task whose commands consolidate the seed, run --select tag:daily --target prod, and test --select tag:daily calls into one semicolon-joined string ('dbt seed; dbt run --select tag:daily --target prod; dbt test --select tag:daily;'), package_manager: POETRY (from the pyproject.toml/poetry.lock signal), and project_dir: dbt_project.

assertions.text: commands includes the selective, targeted run step
commands includes the selective test step
package_manager is set to POETRY based on the pyproject.toml/poetry.lock signal in the source comment
project_dir is carried over as 'dbt_project', matching DbtCoreOperation(project_dir="dbt_project")
The three list items passed to DbtCoreOperation(commands=[...]) are consolidated into a single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task's semicolon-joined commands string rather than split into three separate tasks

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_shell_operation_build.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task (ShellOperation running dbt CLI is treated identically to DbtCoreOperation) with commands: 'dbt build --select tag:nightly;', project_dir set to 'transform' (from the working_dir), and package_manager flagged with a # MANUAL: comment since no lockfile/requirements.txt is visible anywhere in the source to infer PIP/POETRY/UV.

assertions.text: The build command with its --select flag is preserved in commands
project_dir is carried over as 'transform', matching ShellOperation(working_dir="transform")
package_manager is flagged with a MANUAL comment for the user to confirm, rather than silently defaulting to PIP with no supporting signal

The ShellOperation(commands=["dbt build ..."]) call is converted to integration DBT_CORE / integration_job DBT_CORE_EXECUTE exactly as if it had been a DbtCoreOperation, not treated as a generic shell/Python task

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_cloud_job_trigger.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single task with integration: DBT and integration_job: DBT_RUNJOB (the dbt Cloud pair, not DBT_CORE/DBT_CORE_EXECUTE), parameters.job_id: '987654' carried over from DbtCloudJob(job_id=987654), with account_id (54321) represented on the dbt Cloud connection rather than as a task parameter.

assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
The task uses the DBT integration (dbt Cloud pair), not DBT_CORE
The task runs the DBT_RUNJOB job
job_id 987654 is carried over into parameters.job_id
account_id (54321) is not invented as a task parameter — it belongs on the dbt Cloud connection, not duplicated in parameters
No DBT_CORE/DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task is produced for this dbt Cloud job — the Cloud and Core integration pairs are not conflated
